params.complex.title: Complex Model Parameters
params.complex.description: Sampling and reasoning defaults for the more-capable model (rewrite, browser automation).
params.temperatureHint: Higher values make output more random, lower values more focused. Range 0–2.
params.maxTokensHint: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response. Leave empty for the model default.
params.topPHint: Nucleus sampling: consider tokens comprising this probability mass. Range 0–1.
params.frequencyPenaltyHint: Penalize tokens that have appeared frequently. Range -2 to 2.
params.presencePenaltyHint: Penalize tokens that have appeared at least once. Range -2 to 2.
params.topKHint: Only consider the top K tokens at each step. Leave empty for the model default.
reasoning.title: Reasoning / Thinking
reasoning.hint: Controls for the model's reasoning mode. Options come from the model's catalog entry — models that declare none show nothing here.
